profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Technical Lead at Microsoft | OpenTelemetry | GenAI Observability
profile.summary: 14+ years at Microsoft building developer platforms and observability products. Leading JavaScript, Web, Node.js, and Python SDK engineering across Azure Monitor and Microsoft GenAI observability. OpenTelemetry Approver in JavaScript and Python and Code Owner of LangChain and OpenAI instrumentations in OpenTelemetry JS.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer | Technical Lead
positions.description:
Serve as lead architect and technical owner for Microsoft's JavaScript (Web + Node.js) and Python observability SDKs, serving thousands of customers and processing millions of telemetry events daily.
Current priorities:
- Drive observability SDK strategy and technical alignment across Microsoft product and platform teams
- Expand adoption of the Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro across Microsoft AI platform teams
- Lead the next-generation OpenTelemetry-compatible Web SDK

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned technical direction and delivery for Azure Monitor's JavaScript (Web + Node.js) and Python observability SDKs, serving thousands of customers and processing millions of telemetry events daily.

Technical Leadership
- Led engineering across 3 language ecosystems and 15+ repositories
- Designed the next-generation OpenTelemetry-compatible Web SDK from the ground up
- Drove integrations with 10+ Microsoft teams, including App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Foundry, A365, and Adobe

GenAI Observability
- Code Owner of LangChain and OpenAI instrumentations in OpenTelemetry JS
- Worked on the unified Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro to consolidate fragmented GenAI instrumentation across Microsoft

Open Source
- OpenTelemetry Approver in JavaScript and Python, active in 3 SIGs
- Represented Microsoft in the Web/Browser SIG, helping shape browser observability standards

Impact
- Node.js ingestion: +50% (1.36M to 2.04M daily events)
- Python ingestion: +49%
- Web SDK: 3.36M+ daily events

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Designed and built a web analytics portal from scratch (React, Redux), sub-second queries on millions of records
- Built the UI and frontend architecture for an internal support tool, introduced modern frameworks adopted by the team
- Core contributor to Microsoft's 1st-party telemetry SDK: built QoS tracking, automatic request tracking (XMLHTTPRequest/FetchApi), helped design convergence between 1st and 3rd party SDKs
- Drove TypeScript adoption across the engineering team with prototypes, presentations, and tooling
- Improved device service reliability from ~60% to ~93% through systematic telemetry instrumentation
- Built first fully automated CI/CD pipeline (build + Azure deployment) for the team
- Proactively onboarded partners (Xbox and others) to telemetry platforms, audited implementations, created action plans

positions.title: SDET
positions.description:
- Built test automation infrastructure for Microsoft's Messenger Web Client (P0/P1 scenarios, group conversations, security/XSS testing)
- Created the Messaging Web API client to replace a deprecated service, enabling test automation continuity for the Messenger/Skype transition
- Inherited Find My Phone service at ~60% QoS, improved Ring QoS to 93% through systematic investigation
- Built telemetry aggregation infrastructure (MDS, Cosmos, SQL) giving the team daily service health snapshots
- Created reports and dashboards for QoS, error analysis, and operations per OS/device

positions.title: Enterprise Program Analyst Level 3
positions.description: Developed internal enterprise applications supporting global operations, contributing across design, implementation, and testing. Built a permission‑approval system that integrated multiple legacy platforms. This role was also where I deepened my experience with the .NET ecosystem.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · ASP.NET MVC · C# · LINQ · jQuery · SQL Server · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Contributed to multiple client projects as a full‑stack Java developer, handling requirements analysis, system design, and implementation. Took ownership of a delayed project and delivered the full application end‑to‑end.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · PostgreSQL · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · JavaBeans · Hibernate · Java Swing

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built and tested a real‑estate appraisal system using ASP.NET and SQL Server, contributing to backend and UI modules.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET · AJAX · C# · SQL Server · Web Services

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Designed and maintained the university sports website, building interactive Flash tools and PHP/MySQL subsystems.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · CSS · PHP · Adobe Flash · MySQL · JavaScript
